deck: Trump vows a tax on overseas data centres · Korea’s exams begin · A Palisades Fire verdict

leads.headline: Trump vows a “tremendous tax” on data centres built abroad
leads.detail: He says the United States must win the AI contest with China. The remarks come as AI and semiconductor shares fall after Anthropic’s market debut.

leads.headline: South Korea’s essay and interview exams begin
leads.detail: Authorities say 111 students were caught in smart-device cheating on this year’s CSAT. The education ministry urged tighter supervision.

leads.headline: Rinderknecht found guilty in the Palisades Fire
leads.detail: Jonathan Rinderknecht is found guilty at his second trial of sparking the 2025 fire, which killed 12 people.

features.headline: Australia strikes an AI deal
features.detail: The deal with China is on talks about artificial intelligence.

features.headline: Students rally across Europe
features.detail: They march over the cost of living, war, and education cuts.

features.headline: Korea raised with Xi and Putin
features.detail: Trump says the peninsula was discussed, and he gives no details.

features.headline: Alcaraz beats Flavio Cobolli
features.detail: He wears an elastic band on an injured thigh at the ATP Finals.

features.headline: Anthropic falls after its IPO
features.detail: Its value drops after the record IPO, and technology shares fall.

features.headline: No proof on a Gaza freelancer
features.detail: Israel’s military declines or ignores ABC’s Hamas-evidence requests.

features.headline: Reinaldo Dennes screams at execution
features.detail: He reported excruciating pain. The state denies it was botched.

features.headline: Rejoining the EU stays open
features.detail: After a UK–EU summit, reports say the idea is “on the table.”

briefs.headline: Universities form emergency teams for the essay and interview exams amid cheating concerns.
briefs.detail: No clear technical fix is reported.
